description: The Gone Abat Jap irrigation dataset contains JSON and Excel inputs and allocation outputs for a canal network in Uzbekistan. It documents 36 nodes, 35 directed edges and 20 delivery points over 16 ten-day periods. The metadata is published or maintained by Kudaybergenov, Adilbay; Kabulov, Anvar; Kazimbetova, Mukhabbad and coauthors (provider deposit/publication). Coverage is at regional scale in Uzbekistan. Any further spatial resolution, complete time span or sampling interval beyond the details above is not verified here. The provider landing page describes access to CSV, Excel, JSON material. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support network flow. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. Related catalogue context is data-fao-aquastat-main-database. This is a thematic comparison, not a verified software dependency or claim of compatible inputs.
